typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsNonSTPTradeVolumeArchive_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LoadDate as string,
		DEALSRCE as string,
		NONSTP_COUNT as string,
		LSTMNTDATE as timestamp,
		TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblOpicsNonSTPTradeVolumeMaxRecordStaging
tblOpicsNonSTPTradeVolumeMaxRecordStaging sink(input(
		LoadDate as string,
		DEALSRCE as string,
		NONSTP_COUNT as string,
		LSTMNTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		DEALSRCE,
		NONSTP_COUNT,
		LSTMNTDATE,
		TYPE),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsNonSTPTradeVolumeArchive_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsNonSTPTradeVolumeArchive
